purpose: Qualify the research-only NonfinitePositionPolicy::RejectLeaf as an explicit opt-in for deterministic finite-or-recoverable targets. No default changes under any outcome.

sspd_repaired.definition: polyscope-canonical-v2 state space, a = 1, T = 1000; frozen sspd11_confirmation_v1 source included by path; fatal-classified target results reclassified recoverable

neal_funnel_10d.definition: omega ~ N(0, 9), x_i ~ N(0, exp(omega)), 9 latents; exp(-omega) overflow recoverable

run_plan.order: target order sspd_repaired, neal_funnel_10d, gaussian_100d; within target seed ascending; within seed arms_order
run_plan.rerun_policy: never; nonzero exit, timeout or missing record is a result

gates.G1_identity_controls: every control seed: both arms complete, equal draw hash, equal total target calls, reject rejections == 0; 12/12
gates.G3_informativeness: abort fails >= 1 sspd_repaired cell with ErrorKind::Numerical and the nonfinite-position message
gates.G4_health: every completed reject sspd_repaired cell: all nine monitored coordinates rhat <= 1.01, ess_bulk >= 400, ess_tail >= 400
gates.G5_confinement: every reject sspd_repaired cell: retained-phase nonfinite rejections == 0
gates.G6_consistency: every sspd_repaired seed where abort completed: reject rejections == 0 and equal draw hash and total target calls

decision.UNINFORMATIVE: G3 fails and G1, G2, G4, G5, G6 pass

predictions.P2: abort fails between 1 and 8 of 24 sspd_repaired cells
predictions.P5: every rejection occurs within the first 100 warmup transitions
